text: おれたちの　じゃまを　する　やつは　じゃま　なのだ！

structure.jp: おれたちの　じゃまを　する　やつは
structure.en: anyone who gets in our way

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: おれたちの　じゃまを　する　やつ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a person tells you which person is meant, like English 'who…'. おれたちの じゃまを する やつ = 'a guy who gets in our way'

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end makes a statement sound firm, like declaring 'that's how it is'; after a word like じゃま it becomes なのだ. じゃま なのだ = 'is a nuisance, I tell you!'
